def_en: 1) what is conspicuous, what is in front of
2) in front of, straight forward, before, in sight of
4) before your face, in your view or purpose
5) what is in front of, corresponding to
7) in the sight or presence of
12) from the front of, away from
13) from before the eyes of, opposite to, at a distance from
15) as far as the front of
kjv: about, (over) against, [idiom] aloof, [idiom] far (off), [idiom] from, over, presence, [idiom] other side, sight, [idiom] to view.
expl: a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before
